This work presents FACT-PICO, an expert-constructed factuality benchmark for the plain language summarization of technical abstracts describing RCTs.
LLMs may provide a means for lay readers to access such findings by automatically summarizing and simplifying texts into plain language.
outputs: plain language summaries of RCT abstracts

We first evaluate a suite of existing automatic factuality metrics shown to be effective in prior work. (1) Dependency-Arc Entailment (DAE)... (2) QuestEval... (3) QAFactEval... (4) AlignScore... We also report ROUGE-L, Flesch‑Kincaid Grade and BERTScore.
We evaluate a suite of existing automatic factuality metrics shown to perform well for factuality in summarization, as well as newly devised LLM-based evaluations.
We prompt LLMs with instructions emulating the questions asked of human evaluators in FACTPICO.
We also present an analysis of methods to evaluate factuality, including both dedicated factuality models and novel LLM-based methods.
Prior work has also shown that LLMs themselves can be good evaluators for factuality in summarization.
criteria: factuality with respect to PICO elements

quote: FACTPICO was annotated by two senior students in their fifth year of medical school who are highly proficient in English.

FACTPICO was annotated by two senior students in their fifth year of medical school who are highly proficient in English. We ask evaluators to provide a rating between 1 to 4 for each PICO element, evidence inference and added information, and to provide natural‑language rationales.
FACTPICO was annotated by two senior students in their fifth year of medical school who are highly proficient in English.
guideline: Annotators are shown a 'source' input ... and asked a series of 7 questions for evaluation.
Evaluators rate each PICO element, evidence inference, and added information on a 1‑4 scale and justify their rating with a free‑text rationale.
Evaluators are asked to provide a rating between 1 to 4 codifying the factuality with respect to each PICO element... and provide natural language rationales to justify their ratings.
